meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 会把你的多个 git 工作区、分支或 PR 当作参会代表,在共享聊天室里以只读方式轮流发言,比较彼此的改动、重叠和冲突;讨论结束后,它写出一份合并计划:以哪个工作区为目标、合并顺序、还剩哪些决定由你拍板。
howto.when: 当你想对多个 git 工作区、分支或 PR 做一次只读站会式对比,并汇总成一份合并计划时触发;它会先展示候选清单等你确认,再逐轮主持讨论。

say.text: 对比一下这几个分支的改动,给我一份合并计划。
say.note: 它会列出候选清单,确认后开始逐轮讨论。

say.text: 把最近 24 小时活跃的工作区都拉来开站会。
say.note: 没指定窗口时会让你选 1h/4h/24h/7d/全部。

say.text: 看看我的两个 PR 会不会冲突,怎么整合?
say.note: 它会用 gh 读取 PR 并带入房间。

howto.what_en: Claude treats each git worktree, branch, or PR as one voice in a shared chat room. They compare changes and conflicts, then Claude writes a consolidation plan: target worktree, merge order, and decisions left for you.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to compare or consolidate multiple worktrees, branches, or PRs (e.g., a standup). It confirms the roster, then hosts round-based discussion.

say_en.text: Compare these branches and give me one merge plan.
say_en.note: It lists candidates, asks you to confirm, then starts rounds.

say_en.text: Hold a standup for worktrees active in the last 24 hours.
say_en.note: If no window is given, it offers 1h/4h/24h/7d/all.

say_en.text: Do my two PRs conflict? How should I consolidate them?
say_en.note: It reads PRs via gh and brings them into the room.
